name: MHADA Pune housing lottery
title: MHADA Pune housing lottery (4,462 homes): status and draw date
summary: The MHADA Pune board's lottery for 4,462 homes in Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad and the district. Information only: Avasetu takes no applications or payments.
means: Apply and pay only on MHADA's own website. Nobody can get you a home outside the draw: people offering that have cheated applicants in Pune.

faq.q: When is the MHADA Pune lottery draw?
faq.a: It was delayed beyond 10 December 2026, as reported on 21 October. This page changes when MHADA gives the date.
Over 2.11 lakh applications for 4,462 homes, about 61 applicants for every home, a record response.

history.status: The application deadline was extended again, to 30 October.
Over 2.11 lakh applications came in for 4,462 homes, and the draw is delayed beyond 10 December.
Applications are closed with a record response, about 61 applicants for every home; the draw for the 4,462 homes is due after 10 December.
